missing_note: A cycle that could not be fetched, or whose covering set was incomplete, appears here. It is never silently absent from the series.

offset_provenance.effect_on_sigma: none -- a constant per-city shift moves bias_f by exactly its own value and leaves sigma_f unchanged
offset_provenance.why: max and mean do not commute; the live path maximises each member then averages, the backfill averages then maximises

resolution_note: 0.5 deg (pgrb2ap5) carries the same field in a ~3.1x smaller record and was measured and rejected: its nearest node is 24-31 km from three of the four settlement stations and the daily highs disagree by up to 5.2 F. See reports/phase2/ws_f_report.md.
spread_rule: gespr TMAX at the interval where geavg attains its daily maximum
